SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

# ── 盘前 ──
3 7 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/data_quality_check.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_quality.log 2>&1

# ── 盘中/收盘 ──
25 14 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /usr/bin/python3 scripts/daily_signal_a_grouped.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_signal.log 2>&1
10 15 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /usr/bin/python3 -c "from web.services.regime_service import refresh_regime; refresh_regime()" >> /root/quant/logs/cron_regime.log 2>&1
35 15 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /usr/bin/python3 scripts/track_nav.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_nav.log 2>&1

# ── 盘后数据 ──
# 全市场日线增量(约25分钟)，必须在下面的 regime 刷新之前跑完。
# 2026-09-08加: ionice -c3(空闲类, 只在磁盘闲时IO, 防挤死SSH/PAM) + timeout 3h
# (源故障时MCP兜底26.5s/只会拖到深夜, 20:00前必须死, 缺的数据次日补洞自愈)
0 17 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && timeout 3h ionice -c 3 nice -n 10 /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/daily_data_update.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_data_update.log 2>&1
# 上证日线补齐 + regime 回填。原为16:10，此时新浪日线尚未出当日bar导致长期"0 bars saved"
42 17 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python -c "from web.scheduler import _update_daily_data; _update_daily_data()" >> /root/quant/logs/cron_daily.log 2>&1
# ETF晚场补跑: 新浪ETF接口比个股发布晚, 17:49那趟常拿不到当日bar
37 19 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python -c "from scripts.daily_data_update import _update_etf_daily; from datetime import date; _update_etf_daily(str(date.today()))" >> /root/quant/logs/cron_etf.log 2>&1
# 做T信号盘后结算(验证期基准: 胜率≥90%/单次≥+0.15%)
45 15 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/settle_t_signals.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_t_settle.log 2>&1
# 盘前检查: 数据完整性+MA10触发清单+外盘跳空提示(9:03, 邮件送达)
3 9 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/preopen_check.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_preopen.log 2>&1
# 5分钟线落库(持仓票+上证, 错开15:45做T结算)
2 16 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/save_intraday_5min.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_intraday.log 2>&1
# CB数据周更(周一06:30全量: universe+日线+快照, 约40分钟)
30 6 * * 1 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/build_cb_data.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_cb_data.log 2>&1
# CB信号(每日14:28, 紧跟股票信号; 月调仓日全量轮换, 非调仓日刷新)
28 14 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/cb_signal.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_cb_signal.log 2>&1
2,7,12,17,22,27,32,37,42,47,52,57 * * * * cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/tunnel_watchdog.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_tunnel.log 2>&1

5 18 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/measure_execution_costs.py --report >> /root/quant/logs/cron_cost_report.log 2>&1
10 18 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/p0_alerts.py --sweep >> /root/quant/logs/cron_p0.log 2>&1
20 15 * * 1-5 cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/baseline_snapshot.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_baseline.log 2>&1
50 17 * * 1-5 /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/check_config_alignment.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_config_check.log 2>&1
# IO/内存压力监控(9/8两连崩后加, 连续2次超阈值才告警, 30分钟冷却)
3-58/5 * * * * cd /root/quant && /root/quant/.venv/bin/python scripts/io_monitor.py >> /root/quant/logs/cron_io_monitor.log 2>&1
